title: Round-Robin Grant Crosses Clock Domain Without Synchronizer
bug_signature: UVM_ERROR: [META] b_gnt=1'bx after a_gnt transition; single-flop CDC metastability
rtl:
always_ff @(posedge clk_b)
  b_gnt <= a_gnt;  // Single-flop CDC — metastability risk
expected_root_cause: The grant signal from clock domain A is captured in clock domain B with only a single flip-flop; there is no second synchronizer stage, leaving the design susceptible to metastability when a_gnt transitions near posedge clk_b.
fix_replacement:
// Two-stage synchronizer for a_gnt into clk_b domain
always_ff @(posedge clk_b or negedge rst_b_n) begin
  if (!rst_b_n) begin q1 <= 1'b0; b_gnt <= 1'b0; end
  else          begin q1 <= a_gnt; b_gnt <= q1;  end
end
description: The grant signal from clock domain A is sampled directly in clock domain B without a 2-flop synchronizer, risking metastability.
failure_log: UVM_ERROR: [META] b_gnt=1'bx after a_gnt transition; single-flop CDC metastability
success_log: b_gnt stable after 2-flop synchronizer. No X-propagation detected.
